title: Paddle & Palms
meta_description: This splendid sanctuary is a sprawling haven for family, corporate gatherings, or unforgettable events, offering ample space. Enjoy breathtaking vistas, close proximity to beach access, a private pool, a charming carriage house, and pickleball courts!
description_expanded: Description: Paddle & Palms by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 138 Chivas Lane, Santa Rosa Beach Home Highlights: - Steps to Beach Access - Huge Private Heated Pool with Splash Deck and Spa—Spa and Pool Heated Together - In-Home Elevator (*) - Game Room with Pool Table and Air Hockey Table - 10 Adult Bikes - Event-Friendly - Corporate Retreat - Pickleball Court - Complete Clean Linen Program Details: Welcome to Paddle & Palms—where paradise seamlessly merges with luxury at Seagrove Beach. This Gulf-view retreat encompasses a Main House and Guest House, accommodating up to 38 distinguished guests across nine bedrooms and eight and a half bathrooms. With over six thousand square feet of living space and breathtaking views of the Emerald Coast, it is a veritable slice of heaven just a few steps from the sandy shores. For unforgettable experiences, guests may relax on the splash deck or sitting spa by the pool, surrounded by an array of sun loungers. The outdoor kitchen, equipped with a beverage cooler and grill, is ideal for sunset dining, while plush furniture invites relaxation. The first-floor game room maintains the excitement with air hockey, a pool table, and a large sectional for movie marathons. The bunk rooms offer a delightful experience with one twin-over-twin bed, two queen-over-queen beds, and private bathrooms, perfect for late-night activities. Proceed to the second-floor great room, where polished wood floors and French doors provide an elegant setting for gatherings. Plan your adventures from the comfort of stylish sofas or armchairs, while a wet bar with a wine chiller and ice maker complements dining preparations. The breakfast bar is ideal for quick snacks, and the gourmet kitchen, furnished with high-end appliances, invites culinary creativity. Dine alfresco or relax on the balcony with a sectional, then retire to two guest rooms with king beds, private bathrooms, and balconies. The third-floor primary bedroom serves as your personal sanctuary, featuring a king bed, a soaking tub, and a spacious deck with Gulf views. A bunk room with full-over-full beds and two additional guest bedrooms with king beds all provide access to balconies. Ascend the spiral staircase to the fourth-floor rooftop deck for unrivaled views. The theater room, complete with a 75” TV, sectional couch, and wet bar, ensures cinematic enjoyment. The guest house includes a kitchen, sitting area, queen sleeper sofa, balcony, private bedroom, bathroom, and a washer-dryer for added convenience. Access the beach via Chivas Lane’s private boardwalk or visit Walton Dunes Public Beach on Beachfront Trail. Reserve your dream escape today. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Occupancy: 38 9 Bedrooms / 8 Full Baths / 1 Half Baths / 1 Outdoor Shower First Floor: - Bunk Bedroom: Two Queen-over-Queen Bunk Beds and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Bunk Bedroom: Two Queen-over-Queen Bunk Beds and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Game Room: Large Sectional for Movie Nights Second Floor: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only Third Floor: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Jack and Jill Bathroom - Bunk Room: Two Full-over-Full Bunk Beds, Shared Jack and Jill Bathroom - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Carriage House: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower - Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
